question: 一共有多少笔订单？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

question: 有多少笔订单已经支付成功？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders FROM payments WHERE status='paid'

question: 今年第一季度的订单数量是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-04-01'

question: 各个订单状态分别有多少笔？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: 支付成功的金额总计是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM payments WHERE status='paid'

question: 退款记录一共有多少条？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM refunds

question: 客户分群各有多少人？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers c JOIN customer_segments s ON s.id=c.segment_id GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 商品品类分别有多少种商品？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: 不同区域的客户订单量如何分布？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT r.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

question: 各品类实际卖出了多少件？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','partially_refunded') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 每个营销渠道带来的支付金额是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT c.channel, ROUND(SUM(p.amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM campaigns c JOIN orders o ON o.campaign_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY c.channel

question: 高价值客户在各区域的订单数是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT r.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN customer_segments s ON s.id=c.segment_id WHERE s.name='高价值客' GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

question: 哪些客户既下过订单又发生过退款？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(rf.amount),2) AS refund_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 20

question: 每个活动的支付订单数和支付金额是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ca.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS paid_orders, ROUND(SUM(p.amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM campaigns ca JOIN orders o ON o.campaign_id=ca.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name ORDER BY ca.id

question: 各客户分群购买商品的件数是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM customer_segments s JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','partially_refunded') GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 每个区域的退款金额和退款笔数是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT r.name, COUNT(rf.id) AS refund_count, ROUND(SUM(rf.amount),2) AS refund_amount FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

question: 活动订单与非活动订单的支付金额对比？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT CASE WHEN o.campaign_id IS NULL THEN '无活动' ELSE '有活动' END AS campaign_type, ROUND(SUM(p.amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type

question: 商品成本与成交价的总毛利按品类如何分布？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price-p.cost_price)*oi.quantity),2) AS gross_profit FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','partially_refunded') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 各月份净收入是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT substr(o.ordered_at,1,7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 各区域退款率是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT r.name, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),0),4) AS refund_rate FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

question: 各客户分群的支付客单价是多少？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM customer_segments s JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 各品类支付净收入排名？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(pay.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id=o.id AND pay.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

question: 支付成功订单中发生退款的比例？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),4) AS refund_rate FROM payments p LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='paid'

question: 每个营销渠道的平均支付订单金额？
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ca.channel, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM campaigns ca JOIN orders o ON o.campaign_id=ca.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY ca.channel ORDER BY ca.channel

question: 取消订单金额是否应该计入净收入？请给出排除后的金额。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: 按区域比较支付订单的平均成交金额。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY r.id

question: 销售额按业务口径应该看支付金额还是订单明细金额？请按净收入口径给出结果。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM payments p LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='paid'

question: 订单数按全部创建订单统计，还是按支付成功订单统计？请给支付订单数。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders FROM payments WHERE status='paid'

question: 退款率是退款金额除以支付金额，还是退款订单除以支付订单？按指标目录口径计算。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),4) AS refund_rate FROM payments p LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='paid'

question: 毛利不是收入。请按成交价减商品成本，统计各品类毛利。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price-p.cost_price)*oi.quantity),2) AS gross_profit FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','partially_refunded') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 只看实际付款，不把待支付订单算入客户价值。按分群统计支付金额。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM customer_segments s JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 退款金额不能重复扣除。每个订单的净收入先汇总支付，再减退款。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT o.id, ROUND(COALESCE(pay.paid_amount,0)-COALESCE(rf.refund_amount,0),2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY order_id) pay ON pay.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) rf ON rf.order_id=o.id ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 50

question: 只统计有活动归因的订单，比较活动和自然订单的净收入。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT CASE WHEN o.campaign_id IS NULL THEN '自然订单' ELSE '活动订单' END AS order_type, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY order_type

question: 客户数量和订单数量不能混淆，统计每个分群的客户数以及支付订单数。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status='paid' THEN p.order_id END) AS paid_orders FROM customer_segments s JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 找出华东区域净收入最高的三个商品品类，并说明退款影响。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(pay.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS refund_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id=c.region_id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id=o.id AND pay.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id WHERE r.name='华东' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: 比较高价值客户和成长客户在活动订单中的客单价。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT s.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM customer_segments s JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id AND o.campaign_id IS NOT NULL JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' WHERE s.name IN ('高价值客','成长客') GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.id

question: 按季度比较各营销渠道的净收入，并只保留支付成功订单。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT substr(o.ordered_at,1,4)||'-Q'||((CAST(substr(o.ordered_at,6,2) AS INTEGER)-1)/3+1) AS quarter, ca.channel, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM campaigns ca JOIN orders o ON o.campaign_id=ca.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY quarter,ca.channel ORDER BY quarter,ca.channel

question: 筛选退款率高于整体退款率的区域。
gold_sql_variants: WITH overall AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0) AS rate FROM payments p LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='paid') SELECT r.name, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id),0),4) AS refund_rate FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id=r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY r.id,r.name HAVING refund_rate > (SELECT rate FROM overall) ORDER BY refund_rate DESC

question: 找出支付订单最多的客户分群，再列出该分群的净收入。
gold_sql_variants: WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.segment_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS paid_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' GROUP BY c.segment_id ORDER BY paid_orders DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT s.name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount),0),2) AS net_revenue FROM ranked x JOIN customer_segments s ON s.id=x.segment_id JOIN customers c ON c.segment_id=s.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='paid' LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY s.id,s.name

question: 对比有活动与无活动订单的退款率，并给出差异。
gold_sql_variants: SELECT CASE WHEN o.campaign_id IS NULL THEN '无活动' ELSE '有活动' END AS campaign_type, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rf.order_id) AS REAL)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),0),4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_id=o.id GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type
